description: Fixed evaluation prompts for the university policy question answering flow. Add expected source filenames and key facts after approved policy documents are installed.

cases.question: What attendance requirement applies to students?
cases.expected_behavior: Cite a retrieved official policy passage containing the attendance requirement.

cases.question: How can a student request a review of an examination result?
cases.expected_behavior: Cite a retrieved official policy passage describing the review process, if present.

cases.question: What exact penalty applies to a third library book overdue by more than 41 days?
cases.expected_behavior: Abstain unless an official policy passage directly supports the detail.

cases.question: Does the university reimburse students for buying a private car?
cases.expected_behavior: Abstain when no relevant official policy passage is available.
